newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia bourse says H1 turnover tops 1996 total.
newsitem.headline: Croatia bourse says H1 turnover tops 1996 total.

text.p: Croatia's central bourse said on Wednesday livelier activity in the first six months of this year bolstered its turnover so that it overshot the total for the whole of 1996.
"Turnover so far this year amounts to 1.223 million kuna, compared to 1.2 million in all of 1996," the Zagreb Stock Exchange said in a news release.
This was in part due to increasing interest from foreign investors and a new on-line trading system, enabling quicker communication between brokers and more deals, it said.
"New listings in the top bracket, growing bourse membership and more intense cooperation between the bourse and issuers resulted in the turnover rise and a new awakening of the capital market."
The bourse said it would continue to develop its trading system and the market in line with the international standards.
